identificationModule.briefTitle: Evaluate the Immunogenicity and Safety of 4-valent and 9-valent HPV Recombinant Vaccine in Chinese Healthy Females
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blind and Positive-Controlled Phase 3 Study to Evaluate the Immunogenicity and Safety of the 4-valent Human Papillomavirus (Types 6, 11, 16, 18) Recombinant Vaccine (Hansenula Polymorpha) and 9-valent Human Papillomavirus (Types 6, 11, 16, 18,31,33,45,52 and 58) Recombinant Vaccine (Hansenula Polymorpha) in Chinese Female Subjects Aged 20-45 Years

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study will evaluate the immunogenicity and safety of 4-valent and 9-valent HPV recombinant vaccine in Chinese healthy females 20 to 45 years of age.

armGroups.label: 4-valent HPV Vaccine
armGroups.description: Participants in this arm would receive 4-valent Human Papillomavirus (Types 6, 11, 16 and18) Recombinant Vaccine (Hansenula Polymorpha)

armGroups.label: 9-valent HPV Vaccine
armGroups.description: Participants in this arm would receive 9-valent Human Papillomavirus (Types 6, 11, 16, 18,31,33,45,52 and 58) Recombinant Vaccine (Hansenula Polymorpha)

armGroups.label: GARDASIL®
armGroups.description: Participants in this arm would receive GARDASIL®

interventions.name: 4-valent HPV Vaccine
interventions.description: Subjects received 3 doses of 4-valent HPV vaccine according to a 0, 2, 6-month schedule.

interventions.name: 9-valent HPV Vaccine
interventions.description: Subjects received 3 doses of 9-valent HPV vaccine according to a 0, 2, 6-month schedule.

interventions.name: GARDASIL®
interventions.description: Subjects received 3 doses of GARDASIL® according to a 0, 2, 6-month schedule.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of participants 20 to 45 Years of Age that achieve the neutralizing antibody serostatus cutoffs for seroconversion to HPV Types 6, 11, 16 and 18 at least 1 month post Dose 3.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The neutralizing antibody GMTs for HPV Types 6, 11, 16 and 18 in participants 20 to 45 Years of Age at least 1 month post Dose 3.
